- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >45), model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly; reduce forecast by 5–10% in subsequent days.
- When sentiment is neutral or flat (all 0.00), model exhibits high volatility and overconfidence; dampen forecast variance and anchor to recent 7-day moving average.
- True outcomes often show sudden drops (e.g., 34.33, 33.70) after high peaks — model fails to anticipate sharp mean reversion; add a 3–5 day lagged low filter.
- If true outcome dips below 35 after a peak, model should adjust downward by 3–8% for next 3–5 days, regardless of sentiment.
- Forecast horizon 30d is prone to overfitting to recent trends; reduce weight on last 3–5 data points when sentiment is flat or negative.
